Routes and commutes

Riding an Ather around Chidambaram, Cuddalore and Neyveli

Our Chidambaram showroom serves a wide area — from Sirkazhi to Cuddalore and Neyveli — with a mix of town streets, state highways and village roads. That mix shapes which Ather we recommend, and how owners here charge.

Updated 12 November 2026 · 2 min read · Pillai Auto, authorised Ather dealer

Riding an Ather around Chidambaram, Cuddalore and Neyveli

  1. Distances that matter
  2. Choosing for mixed roads

Distances that matter

Trip from ChidambaramApprox. one wayRound trip on one charge?
Sirkazhi20 kmYes, any Ather
Cuddalore45 kmYes with 2.7 kWh and above
Neyveli45 kmYes with 2.7 kWh and above
Kattumannarkoil25 kmYes, any Ather

For a daily round trip of 90 km or more, choose the 3.5 kWh battery for a comfortable margin.

Choosing for mixed roads

Village roads and broken patches favour the Konarc: its 14-inch front wheel, long-travel suspension and 16 cm ground clearance make rough stretches far more comfortable. Families who travel two-up to temple and market often prefer the Rizta for its seat and storage. Riders who spend most of their time on the highway towards Cuddalore will enjoy a 450X.

Charging here

Most owners in the region charge at home — independent houses make it simple, with a properly earthed socket near where the scooter is parked. Ather Grid is growing across the region; check the Ather app for points on your regular routes, and plan longer trips around them. See the fast charging guide.

Heat, dust and rain

  • Park in shade where you can; Cuddalore district summers are hard on any battery. See battery care in the heat.
  • Coastal and village roads carry sand — ride gently on it, and the Rizta Z's SkidControl helps.
  • During the north-east monsoon, avoid waterlogged roads entirely. See the monsoon guide.

Service without the trip to Chennai

Our Chidambaram showroom on the Cuddalore Bye-Pass Road, Thillainayagapuram, handles sales, periodic service, battery checks and warranty work for the whole area, so there is no need to travel to a city for an Ather service.
